defect_observations.label: annex:p02-w02-p02-019-hp
defect_observations.observation: Invariant (c) is asserted to hold 'Before step (2) and after each complete iteration of step (2)'. With a positive unit clause present it fails before step (2) (M is empty while that clause has cnt[j]=0) and between iterations of step (2); the text itself concedes 'after it (c) holds'. The conclusion only uses (c) after step (2) and through step (3), so the argument is intact, but the stated scope of the invariant is wrong. Correctness/presentation, not counted against coverage.

defect_observations.label: annex:p02-w02-p02-019-scc
defect_observations.observation: Facts 1-3 for the second pass (Visit^R on G^R) are carried over 'by the same proofs' with 'unvisited' substituted for 'white' rather than written again. Judged not to make the proof partial, because the transferred arguments are written in full at lines 150-174 and apply word for word under the stated renaming. Flagged because the rule treats 'similarly' as partial.

defect_observations.label: thm:p02-horn-sat, thm:p02-two-sat, thm:p02-xor-sat
defect_observations.observation: The mapped declarations still carry cited= status (DowlingGallier1984, AspvallPlassTarjan1979, Schaefer1978), although complete written proofs now exist at thm:p02-w02-p02-019-horn-procedure, thm:p02-w02-p02-019-two-sat and thm:p02-w02-p02-019-xor (019 body 200-202, 375-383, 503-505 say so). The D-P2-008-01 queue entry's remaining_work ('full algorithm proofs remain cited') no longer matches the text. Bookkeeping only.

defect_observations.label: def:p02-tractable-classes
defect_observations.observation: 'Horn list' and '2-CNF list', used as input types throughout the 019 section (body 22, 108, 151, 268, 331), have no explicit defining sentence. The definition calls a clause Horn and calls a clause set 2-CNF, while the procedures take clause lists (def:p02-w02-p02-019-clause-input). The intended class, a clause list all of whose members are Horn or have at most two literals, is unambiguous from 'The corresponding satisfiability problems restrict their inputs to these classes', so this is not counted as a gap.

defect_observations.label: def:p02-w02-p02-019-implication-graph
defect_observations.observation: 'implication graph' names two different objects: the literal graph G_S of a 2-CNF list here, and the CDCL trail graph of def:p12-cdcl-apparatus (handbook/parts/p12/sat-and-certificates.tex 202-243). Both go to the same index entry \index{implication graph}, and neither text points to the other or says how they differ.
